title.purpose: Row title in a long list: sessions, FAQ, clippings.

label.purpose: Mono section label, uppercase by CSS, 0.28em tracking.

label-xs.purpose: Micro mono (avatar counts, kit tags, portrait captions). 0.6875rem = 11px, the mono floor: no mono label sets smaller.

shadows.name: print-mount
shadows.purpose: A photograph is mounted, not floated: keyline plus shadow.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: The standard control transition: buttons, inputs, links.

motion.name: cover
motion.purpose: The header mark and Tickets fading out while the home hero covers them.

motion.name: field
motion.purpose: The row reach field colour and opacity fade.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: The house arrive curve: sheet entry, row pull.

motion.name: develop
motion.purpose: The signature motion: a B&W photograph develops to colour on hover (gallery collage, facts mill plate, venue route photos) and the speaker prints via [data-developed]: per tile on /speakers while that tile is hovered or focused, on the home credits while a row is. With the portrait view transition, the only decorative motion. No page entry, no scroll reveal.

narrative.overview: A film-noir darkroom with one light: a single dark ground, cream ink, and red spent as a field or a fill rather than as small text. Headlines are poster-scale condensed caps, body copy is a typewriter face used as texture, labels are tracked mono. Depth comes from tonal panels, hairlines and a raking wash; nothing glows. Photographs rest in B&W and develop to colour on hover. Lists carry no rules; the reach state marks an entry.
keyCharacteristics: One theme, and it is dark
Red is a field, a fill or a rule, never small text
Three faces: Bebas Neue, Special Elite, JetBrains Mono
Lists without rules; the red reach field on hover
No glow: hover and live states are flat colour changes
No icon library; glyphs are text

rules.name: The Red Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Brand manual v1.0: three colours, #000000, #FFFFFF, #F11000. Red marks details (a dot, 1-2 headline words, the year, CTA words) and, as a large area, only red bands, title bars and primary CTA fills. Never running text, never a wash, never another accent hue.

rules.name: The Size Not Dimming Rule
rules.body: On the red field, hierarchy comes from size. Ink is #000000 at full opacity (4.8:1 on #F11000); 85% black is for control boundaries only; white only for large type (4.4:1).

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: One --fs-display element per page. Sections run at --fs-h2.

rules.name: The One Red Word Rule
rules.body: The red accent word and the closing full stop belong to the home hero statement (and the invite title). Every subpage hero title carries neither; section heads and every Closer title are plain cream.

rules.name: The No Fake Styles Rule
rules.body: font-synthesis: none. One weight per face and no italic, so prose emphasis is ink (strong steps up to --color-text). Czech letters Special Elite lacks fall to JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The No Decorative Lines Rule
rules.body: A hairline only where it carries structure: the agenda grid, data tables, control boundaries (the press kit's format chips included), link underlines, progress spines, the cookie banner edge. No section dividers, no rule under a head or above the hero's footing line, no ruled readouts, no left-edge lines, no tiles or borders behind partner logos.

rules.name: The Motion Answers A Change Rule
rules.body: No scroll reveal, no per-section entrance, no page-entry animation: the hero lands still. One signature motion: a B&W photograph develops to colour on hover (gallery collage, mill plate, venue photos, speaker prints). Only the home hero's topic rotor (captioned "On the programme", shown on phones too) and the countdown move on their own; no ticker, no marquee, no scroll strip; the agenda's live dot is static. Hover painting on rows only under (hover: hover).

rules.name: The Recipe Rule
rules.body: Every font declaration goes through _type.scss (mono, display, row-title, prose, hairline-link); every font-size through the ramp.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No glow anywhere. Hover and live states are flat colour changes: an inverted fill for buttons, a border or ink change for rows and fields. The print mount stays: a photograph is mounted, not floated.

rules.name: The Size By Tier Rule
rules.body: Partner logos sit on the page ground with no tile, border or plate, each in its original colours (brand manual p. 15); dark-ink masters on a paper-white card. Rank reads from size: opticalBox() gives each mark equal ink area within its tier's reference box (Platinum 600x300, Diamond 288x176, Gold/Silver 246x150, Media/Community 200x110) on a left-set grid whose column is the box width; a mark at ratio ≥6 spans two cells. Every tier heading is Bebas --fs-h3; on a phone every tier but Platinum sets two to a row at 0.8. The home strip reuses the boxes at 70% under a mono "Partners" label.

rules.name: The End Line Rule
rules.body: A Closer ends a page that asks for a decision (speakers, agenda, workshops, venue, invite). A page that asks for none ends on an EndLine (one lede line and one hairline link) or on its content (legal pages, 404's step list).

rules.name: The Earned Noir Rule
rules.body: Noir wordplay is spent in a few earned places: the home hero statement, the 404 "Nothing filed under that", "Follow the leads.", "Starring", "Buy your way in", "See them in the room.". Every other title says plainly what it is ("Speakers", "Partners", "The team", "Questions", "Become a partner"). No triads, no em-dash chains, no hype words.

rules.name: The One Date Format Rule
rules.body: Event facts come from src/lib/event.ts: doors 08:00, keynote 09:00, close 19:00, afterparty to 23:00. "30 October 2026" in running copy, "30 Oct 2026" in stamps, never "October 30"; 24-hour HH:MM; British "programme".

dos: Do use global primitives by class name (.band, .eyebrow, .display, .field-row, .btn-primary, .btn-ghost).
Do give every data-backed page a .fallback-note.
Do use --field-border (≥3:1) for any interactive control boundary.
Do add a prefers-reduced-motion opt-out to every animation.
Do use .hairline-link for every "see all" or next-step link.
Do head a list of next steps with NextStepList's mono label, an <ol> when the steps are a sequence.
Do render every partner mark through the partner-logo() recipe and its LogoMono mode.
donts: Don't add a fourth font, an icon package, Tailwind or CSS-in-JS.
Don't set paragraphs in #F11000, add a second red or any other accent hue, or use --color-error as an accent.
Don't add rules, boxes or opacity 'inactive' states to a list.
Don't paint the reach field on :focus; focus draws a ring.
Don't introduce a prefers-color-scheme block for a single component.
Don't use translateX on the red reach field; the pull belongs to the warm wash.
Don't stack a second poster headline under a hero that already names the band; give the band an sr-only h2.
Don't put a mood eyebrow ('Be there', 'Join us') on a closer; an eyebrow carries a fact or nothing.
Don't add a glow, a lift or a drop shadow to a hover or live state.
Don't draw a tile, border or plate behind a partner logo; size carries the tier.
Don't set a mono label under 11px (--fs-label-xs is the floor).
Don't typeset the DevFest.cz name as a second wordmark; use the official logo file.
Don't spend noir wordplay on a plain title; name the page.
